scenario: The ego vehicle drives on a narrow residential road at night and encounters a pedestrian suddenly running across the road from behind a parked car, followed by a white SUV pulling out from the left side.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward along the narrow road and reacts to unexpected obstacles.

adversarials.behavior: The pedestrian suddenly runs across the road from the left side in front of the ego vehicle.
The car pulls out from the left side of the road and enters the ego vehicle's path.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle travels on a narrow two-way residential road with buildings on both sides, a parked car on the left side, and an approaching vehicle with headlights visible in the distance.
requirements_and_restrictions: The scenario occurs at night with limited visibility; the ego must detect and react to the pedestrian and the pulling-out vehicle in sequence.

road_side_structures.position: Positioned on the right-hand sidewalk near the buildings.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the dashcam vehicle; pedestrian and white SUV are adversarials. 2. Chronology: initially ego approaches parked car and distant headlights; midpoint pedestrian runs from left behind parked car; ending white SUV pulls out from left. 3. Evidence: pedestrian's lateral movement crosses ego path; SUV's position shifts from parked to entering roadway.
